site.name: OneOps
site.meta_description: OneOps is an AI governance platform designed to help organizations manage LLMs and AI tools responsibly, ensuring visibility, governance, and operational efficiency.
site.brand_promise: Every AI key. Every team. One platform.

hero.headline: Every AI key. Every team. One platform.
hero.subheadline: OneOps is the enterprise AI Governance platform which serves as the control plane for enterprise AI. Manage keys, track spend by team and person, enforce budgets, and govern access across every AI model your company uses.

problem_section.headline: Your teams are using 12 AI tools. You have no idea who authorized half of them.

cards.title: Keys scattered everywhere
cards.description: API keys living in Slack threads, Notion pages, and engineers' .env files. No rotation schedule, no audit trail, no visibility into who has what.

cards.title: Spend is a complete mystery
cards.description: You get a $14,000 invoice from Anthropic at month-end and spend two days piecing together which team burned it – with no person-level breakdown anywhere.

cards.title: Zero access governance
cards.description: Marketing has access to the same models as your infrastructure team – no usage policies, no budget limits, no offboarding process when someone leaves.

core_features.headline: Everything your AI operations team needs in one dashboard.

features.title: One vault for every AI key you own
features.description: Centrally store, rotate, and monitor API keys for Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Bedrock, Groq, Mistral, and 40+ other providers. No more keys scattered across .env files and Slack threads.
bullets: Expiry alerts at 14, 7, and 3 days – Slack + email
Full audit log of every key action – who touched what, when
One-click rotation without cycling the underlying provider key

features.title: Know exactly what AI costs – and who.
features.description: Track spending by provider, model, team, and individual member in real time. Set monthly budgets with hard caps. No more end-of-month invoice surprises.
bullets: Per-person spend attribution – every API call tracked to a name
Budget alerts at 50%, 75%, 90% – soft or hard caps
Export spend reports for finance chargebacks

features.title: Give each team the right model.
features.description: Assign specific AI models to specific teams with zero code changes. Dev gets Claude + Bedrock. Marketing gets Gemini. Sales gets GPT-4o. Reconfigure access in seconds.
bullets: SSO/SCIM – auto-provision and deprovision via Okta, Azure AD
Role-based permissions – Admin, Team Lead, Member, Viewer
Instant access revocation – no key rotation required

features.title: Stop sensitive data from leaving your org.
features.description: Every prompt your team sends is scanned in real time before it reaches any LLM provider. Names, emails, SSNs, card numbers, medical records, financial data – all caught and handled before they leave your network.
bullets: Block, redact, or alert – configurable per team or provider
Detects 20+ PII types – names, emails, SSNs, IBANs, health data, and more
Full violation log for GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2 audits
Custom rules – flag internal project names, client IDs, proprietary terms

features.title: Your team's context, auto-injected. Zero waste.
features.description: Build a team-specific knowledge base – brand guidelines, codebase conventions, product specs, client context. OneOps automatically injects the right KB into every LLM request, so your team never has to paste background context again.
bullets: Team-scoped – Marketing, Dev, Sales each get their own KB
Versioned and owned – every doc has an author and review date
Smart injection – only relevant KB chunks sent, not the whole library

extended_capabilities.headline: Powerful capabilities built for your teams — create, collaborate, discover insights, and work smarter.

items.title: Sophia AI
items.description: Go beyond dashboards and discover what is happening across your AI ecosystem. Administrators can interact with Sophia AI to understand team and user token consumption, spending patterns, prompts being used, and overall AI usage across the organization. Sophia also helps administrators stay ahead with budget alerts when a member exceeds their allocated limit and instant notifications when AI providers release new updates, features, or changes across their ecosystem and tools.

items.title: Feedback System
items.description: Capture monthly feedback from users on a recurring basis to understand their experience with OneOps, identify friction points, and surface issues that need attention. Feedback creates a continuous loop between users, administrators, and the OneOps team.

items.title: Prompt Library
items.description: Keep valuable conversations and prompts accessible instead of recreating them every time. Prompt Library automatically retains previous prompts and conversations, allowing users to save, revisit, and retrieve useful prompts whenever they need them.

items.title: Motion Studio
items.description: Bring AI-powered creativity directly into your OneOps experience with integrated Motion Studio capabilities. Users can create and edit videos using intuitive manual tools or prompt-driven workflows, making it easier to turn ideas into engaging visual content.

how_it_works.headline: Connect. Assign. Control.
how_it_works.subtitle: Three steps to full visibility over every AI tool in your company.

steps.title: Connect your providers
steps.description: Paste in your API keys for any AI provider – Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock, Mistral, Groq, and more. OneOps vaults them with AES-256 encryption immediately.

steps.title: Create teams, assign models
steps.description: Set up your teams and choose which AI models each one can access. Define monthly budgets per team or per person. Sync with Okta or Azure AD via SCIM.

steps.title: Track, alert, optimize
steps.description: Watch spend in real time. Get alerts before limits are hit. Rotate keys on schedule. Pull reports for finance. One dashboard for all of it – forever.

testimonials.quote: Finally one place to see that Marketing is burning through Gemini credits and Dev has 3 expired Bedrock keys. We caught a $4,000 overage before it happened.
testimonials.author: Morgan K.

testimonials.quote: When a developer left, we revoked their AI access in 30 seconds from a single screen. Before OneOps that would have been a 2-hour audit across five different provider dashboards.
testimonials.author: Sarah R.

testimonials.quote: Finance asked me which departments were driving our AI costs. I pulled a full breakdown by team, model, and person in 2 minutes. That used to be a week-long spreadsheet exercise.
testimonials.author: Tom L.
